watch.summary: The streamer challenges an enemy to push him, but gets instantly eliminated when he realizes his gun is completely out of ammo.

beats.what: Streamer whispers 'Push me. You got the balls?' while holding a corner.
An enemy turns the corner and the streamer tries to fire.
He shoots a single bullet, runs out of ammo (0 bullets), and gets killed.
He sighs 'Bruh' before screaming in disbelief as Mario edits play.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: Push me. You got the balls?
watch.why: The clip benefits from classic comedic timing: acting tough right before an embarrassing fail. The zoom-in edit on his empty ammo counter highlights the mistake instantly for the viewer.
